name: Noida–Greater Noida Expressway
history: The Noida–Greater Noida Expressway was one of the first modern expressways in the Delhi region, built by the Noida Authority to connect the brand-new town of Greater Noida with Noida and Delhi. It runs along the east side of the Yamuna past offices, colleges and apartment blocks. At the Pari Chowk end it links into the Yamuna Expressway, which continues all the way to Agra.
facts: The Aqua Line metro runs alongside much of the expressway.
Connects to the DND Flyway towards Delhi at one end and to the Yamuna Expressway towards Agra at the other.
Opened in 2002, making it one of the oldest expressways in the National Capital Region.
